topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides introductory framing by connecting the lecture to practical coursework and outlining the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor Viruses and Experimental Assays of Cell Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the discovery of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and led to laboratory assays for measuring malignant transformation.

topics.label: Classification and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major classes of cancer mutations and explain their functional mechanisms and effects on cell cycle checkpoints.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the distinctions between sequence and chromosomal instability as well as the DNA repair, replication, and mitotic defects that produce them.

topics.label: Multistep Tumor Progression and Hereditary Predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the stepwise accumulation of somatic and inherited mutations drives cancer development and tumor evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers concluding administrative remarks, suggests further reading, and previews the next lecture.
